problems: Several hints give away the answer rather than scaffold reasoning. The final check explicitly identifies carbon dioxide as an input and oxygen as an output; the fertilizer check points directly to the only option mentioning both mineral uptake and sugar production.
Retry explanations largely repeat the original explanations rather than offer genuinely different ways to understand the concepts.
The final question is mostly another recognition test of the word equation. Despite its growing-guide framing, it adds little difficulty beyond the earlier sorting activity.
The opening prediction assumes familiarity with carbon and dry plant material, which may be challenging for a beginner with no prior coursework.
